checks.scope: trained checkpoint, synthetic CPU inputs; not a held-out quality evaluation

dense.scope: Finite synthetic full-sequence batch/single-row/permutation probes in eval mode; not a proof for all inputs or training-mode randomness.

right_aligned_histories.scope: Finite synthetic full-sequence batch/single-row/permutation probes in eval mode; not a proof for all inputs or training-mode randomness.

structure.dataflow_coverage: direct_tensor_identity_only; functional transforms and residual arithmetic are not fully traced

parameter_sharing.scope: Registered Parameter object identity and observed module calls during encode_sequence; distinct objects sharing storage and functional parameter reads are not identified as shared calls.

tensor_graph.scope: Dispatched tensor operations for this concrete encode_sequence input and execution mode. Includes functional and mutation dependencies; excludes unexecuted branches, Python scalar/control flow and operator internals. Not a universal static graph or semantic insertion proof.
